title: Raphaelle Kennedy — 'Book of the year for purpose people. I know it's only June but I am calling it!'
summary: Raphaelle Kennedy posts a five-point takeaway thread on Incorruptible and stakes a flag in the first week of June — declaring it the book of the year for the purpose community, eight months before the rest of the year even has a chance.
blockquote:
Book of the year for purpose people. I know it's only June but I am calling it!

"Incorruptible - Why Good Companies Go Bad and Great Companies Stay Great" by Eric Ries is part manifesto and part implementation guide for leaders serious about building mission into the bones of their organisation to help achieve audacious goals and withstand the inevitable pressures that can derail purpose.
